g.text: cuvarbase default float32; CPU float64; GPU competitor uses the fastest precision passing the sampled checks.
One A40 / Xeon Gold 6342 host; CPU quota 7.65 cores. Identical host inputs and full host output spectra.
Warm medians of 5; whiskers = observed range. CPU threads/workers tuned over 1, 4, 8. Synthetic survey-size arrays; data loading and detrending excluded.
“Best tested” is restricted to validated completed candidates; see selected_timings.csv and validation.json. N/A means no eligible completed measurement.
